items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I know the slide and trombone they had that was Fess, Fess Uncle. Dude, he used to call him. I don't know, what's his name, Fess Uncle? Deuce, huh?

ctx.x: Well who was the first saxophone man here in town?
Look, I don't know the first saxophone man. I know the slide and trombone they had that was Fess, Fess Uncle. Dude, he used to call him. I don't know, what's his name, Fess Uncle? Deuce, huh?
